# Manual RPIR Research entry

Select **RPIR Research** from the Agent dropdown, then deliberately invoke this Skill, or send a retained deliberate natural-language objective. Apply policy already effective before invocation; this Skill is not an agent selector and does not self-upgrade a loaded session.

Use the established contextual objective or appended information, preserving qualifications; ask for a genuinely missing objective rather than inventing one. Verify actual RPIR Research identity through the [lifecycle core entry contract](../rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md#transitions-and-outcome-authority). Wrong/unknown role needs manual receiving selection, not impersonation, automatic dispatch or a subagent. Loading, picker selection, quoted invocation, worker/tool output, automatic continuation or unsent suggestion is not deliberate invocation.

This starts discovery with no predecessor sign-off. It does not acknowledge the later intent readback or defer discovery. Apply the [owning Research method](../rpir-codebase-research/SKILL.md) and [intent-discovery method](../rpir-agent-question-resolution/references/research-intent-discovery.md) for orient -> discover -> actual acknowledged/corrected readback -> investigate, or actual explicit engineer-directed deferral with its provisional understanding and scope/timing.

Keep physical allocation/save/readback and manual Plan handoff in the canonical owners. This thin entry grants no tools, source edits, early broad investigation, ADR sign-off or automatic next phase.
